summary: Nerdy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting it received a NYSE notice on September 1, 2026, that it regained compliance with Section 802.01C minimum share price listing standard. The company's Class A common stock average closing price for the 30 trading days ended August 31, 2026, exceeded the $1.00 minimum. No transaction, terms, advisors, or structural changes are involved. This is a compliance milestone, not a special-situation corporate event. What to watch: continued compliance with other NYSE standards to avoid future delisting risk.
